**Nexo v0.4 beta 2** makes games run better while Nexo is open, and adds sound effects and speaking
indicators in the sidebar. Nexo updates itself: look for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** nothing to do, the server didn't change.

## What's new

- **Better game performance.** Nexo could take a whole CPU core away from your game. Any animation on
  screen (like the pulsing dot on the **LIVE** badge while you stream) made Nexo redraw its window about 60
  times a second, even while a game covered it, and on NVIDIA every redraw kept a CPU core busy. Animations
  now pause while Nexo isn't the focused window, which is always the case while you're in a game.
- **Sound effects.** A short sound when you mute, unmute, deafen or undeafen, from the buttons, your
  keybinds or the tray, so you know what happened while you're in a game. Only you hear it, on your selected
  speaker. Push to talk stays silent. Turn it off in **Settings → Audio & video → Sound effects**.
- **Who's talking, in the sidebar.** In the voice channel you're in, whoever is speaking gets a green ring
  next to their name in the sidebar, like on the voice stage.
- **New guides.** The README is now a short landing page. Hosting a server has its own
  [server guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/SERVER.md) (Linux, a VPS or Windows), and
  everything about using Nexo is in the [user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md).

## Install

Already on v0.2.0-alpha.1 or later? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself.

On a **test build** (v0.4.0-test.x)? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart
Nexo. Test builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
